status: reviewed against exact pinned source; native development probe pending
findings: The pinned keymap binds C-x C-c to quit. Before checking whether to exit, quit calls anycb(FALSE), which asks eyorn("Save file <path>") for each changed file.

Declining the Save file prompt makes anycb report changed buffers remain; quit then asks eyesno("Modified buffers exist; really exit"). Declining this second prompt returns to the editor with the unsaved edit intact.

The default short-answer mode routes eyesno through eyorn, so literal text n answers both prompts immediately. The contract checks the buffer remains, saves it with C-x C-s, confirms save status, quits cleanly and checks exact bytes including the existing final newline.
safety: synthetic relative file only; secure mode -S; backups disabled with -n
